Iteration 8/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative:
The new feature_027 battery largely confirms independence and approximate homogeneity. H91 shows feature_027=1 versus 0 in the full clean stratum excluding feature_037, feature_010, feature_002, and feature_063 gives +0.754 [0.683, 0.825], with exposed n=55; this far exceeds the 0.15 threshold and I accept/close it as a dataset-specific association. H92-H94 test feature_027 interactions with the three dominant accepted markers. None shows threshold-exceeding heterogeneity: f037 interaction +0.015 [-0.199,0.229], f010 +0.012 [-0.231,0.255], f002 -0.163 [-0.412,0.087]. I reject those interaction claims, although the sparse cells mean they only show absence of evidence for large heterogeneity rather than precise proof of additivity. The direct subgroup estimates H95-H97 and H100 meet the threshold but have small exposed cells (24, 29, 30, and 21 respectively). I accept them as dataset-specific conditional evidence but defer them; they are not robust enough to become central subgroup claims. Together they support the view that feature_027 is not solely driven by overlap with the dominant markers, but the exact sparse conditional claims should not be overinterpreted.

The feature_003 question is now closed as unresolved. In the strictest clean stratum H99, feature_003=1 versus 0 gives +0.167 [0.110, 0.224]. The point estimate exceeds the threshold, but the interval still includes effects below 0.15, so the evidence does not support a scientifically meaningful effect despite multiple earlier positive near-threshold estimates. H101 gives feature_063 within feature_003=1 as +0.346 [0.128, 0.563], also below threshold in the lower bound and sparse; I leave it unresolved/closed rather than using it to broaden the feature_063 claim. H102 tests feature_053 value 10 versus 2 and is null/near-null; I reject it.

The most important new claim is H98: feature_063 in the clean triple-strong-absent stratum restricted to higher log_pfs_months gives +0.316 [0.200, 0.432], with exposed n=68. This exceeds the threshold and is plausible, but it is a clinical-course subgroup discovery after many feature_063 probes and conditioning on log_pfs can introduce collider-like selection. I therefore accept H98 provisionally but request independent validation of H98. If validation remains threshold-exceeding, the feature_063 association becomes more stable in the clean high-logpfs context; if it does not, I will leave H98 unresolved/closed and keep feature_063 interpreted narrowly around the validated clean triple-strong-absent claim. No validation is requested for H91 because the feature_027 conclusion is already robust from H83 validation and H91/H88 are very strongly threshold-exceeding; preserving validation capacity for H98 is more decisive.

record.narrative:
The due validations complete the immediate feature_063 and low-prevalence-binary decisions. H98 was the clean triple-strong-absent feature_063 claim restricted to higher log_pfs_months. Discovery was +0.316 [0.200, 0.432], but independent validation was only +0.158 [-0.005, 0.321]. The validation point estimate is only barely above the 0.15-unit threshold and its interval includes both null and below-threshold effects, so this clinical-course conditional is not robust. I set H98 unresolved and closed, and therefore do not treat feature_063 as robustly supported in that high-log_pfs stratum. H75 similarly shows why broader or sparse feature_063 claims should remain bounded: discovery within feature_002=1 was +0.365 [0.180, 0.550], but validation was +0.347 [0.072, 0.623], with a wide interval crossing below threshold and null. Because the exposed cell is modest and validation does not stabilize the threshold claim, H75 remains unresolved/closed rather than accepted. H7 and H29 are negative: the feature_058-by-feature_018 interaction validation is near-null and opposite to the claimed direction, and feature_017 validation is null/opposite. Both are rejected and closed.

Supported dataset-specific findings remain coherent. feature_037=1 is robustly associated with stronger composite dependency: H15 gives discovery +0.804 [0.742, 0.867] and validation +0.800 [0.705, 0.895]. feature_010=1 and feature_002=1 are robustly associated with weaker dependency: H41 +0.829 [0.767, 0.891] and H42 +0.810 [0.745, 0.875]. feature_027=1 is also robustly associated with stronger dependency: marginal H35 +0.775 [0.664, 0.885]; clean triple-strong-absent H83 discovery +0.745 [0.666, 0.825] and validation +0.779 [0.675, 0.884]; full-clean excluding feature_063 H91 +0.754 [0.683, 0.825]. The feature_027 interaction battery against feature_037, feature_010, and feature_002 did not support threshold-exceeding heterogeneity, so the accepted associations behave approximately additively in this dataset, although sparse subgroup estimates remain low-confidence corroboration rather than central claims. feature_063=1 is supported in the clean validated triple-strong-absent stratum H55, discovery +0.252 [0.169, 0.335] and validation +0.281 [0.159, 0.403], and in the excluding-feature_027 clean conditional H89 +0.260 [0.182, 0.338]. I keep H52 and H69 accepted/closed as non-sparse discovery-supported conditionals within feature_010=0 and feature_002=0, but their lower bounds are near threshold and they should be interpreted narrowly because many broader or sparse feature_063 variants failed stringent validation.

Negative or closed findings include: research markers feature_007, feature_058, and feature_015 and their tested signature-threshold interactions; the feature_058-by-feature_018 interaction H7; feature_017 H29; many low-prevalence binary markers; nominal categorical probes H36 and H78-H82 and H90; and the feature_053 contrast value 10 versus value 2 H102. These negative results are dataset-specific and do not establish biological inertness in other populations.

Unresolved uncertainty is now mainly near-threshold or sparse structure rather than the core marker pattern. feature_003 remains a positive but not scientifically meaningful candidate: multiple estimates exceed null, but lower bounds do not consistently exceed the 0.15 threshold and the strictest clean stratum H99 is unresolved. Broad or sparse feature_063 claims remain uncertain: H51, H68, H70, H73, H74, H75, and H98 are not accepted as robust. Sparse accepted conditional estimates such as H87, H95, H96, H100, and the pending reciprocal H104-H106 should not be overinterpreted because of small cells and conditioning. All accepted conclusions are observational associations in the supplied dataset, not causal effects or generalizable claims.

The most informative next analysis is to stop refining feature_063 and feature_003, and instead finish a bounded broad-coverage and corroboration phase. The registered reciprocal feature_027 conditionals within feature_037=1, feature_010=1, and feature_002=1 (H104-H106), together with the registered feature_034 contrast H103 and the newly registered common-probe claims for feature_047=1 versus 0, feature_046 level_003 versus level_002, and feature_061 level_003 versus level_002, are the appropriate next analyses. They test whether the dominant markers retain their associations in the feature_027=1 stratum and add limited coverage of untested common predictors. I would not request additional validation unless a new discovery comparison has an adequate exposed cell and a clearly threshold-exceeding lower bound; validation capacity should be preserved for genuinely decisive robustness questions rather than sparse near-threshold claims.

Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. expectation

evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

record.narrative:
No evidence assessments are due at this explore stage. The supported core in this dataset is now fairly stable: feature_037=1 is robustly associated with stronger composite dependency; feature_010=1 and feature_002=1 are robustly associated with weaker dependency; feature_027=1 is robustly associated with stronger dependency, including validation in a clean triple-strong-absent stratum; and feature_063=1 is supported primarily in the clean validated triple-strong-absent context. Broad or sparse feature_063 variants and feature_003 remain near-threshold and should not be repeatedly mined unless a comparison has adequate cells and a clear threshold-exceeding interval. The new proposals therefore focus on completing robustness and independence checks for the core markers, plus a small number of heterogeneity probes.

First, I complete the median-split clinical-course pattern for the central markers. H97 already tested feature_027 in the triple-strong-absent stratum restricted to higher log_pfs_months and met the threshold, but the lower-log_pfs half remains untested. I propose feature_027 in feature_037=0, feature_010=0, feature_002=0 with feature_040<=median. The expected raw feature_027=1 minus 0 contrast is negative, i.e. stronger dependency, so the claim direction is -1 and anticipated raw direction is -1. This is a parented refinement of H97. Alternatives include attenuation or nullity if the feature_027 association is concentrated in one clinical-course stratum. Similarly, H65-H67 accepted lower-log_pfs estimates for feature_037, feature_010, and feature_002 in other-marker-absent strata. I propose direct higher-log_pfs estimates for those three predictors in the corresponding absence strata. Expected raw contrasts are negative for feature_037 (stronger dependency) and positive for feature_010 and feature_002 (weaker dependency). These comparisons complete the low/high log_pfs split for the dominant markers. Earlier interaction tests against the high-log_pfs subgroup did not support threshold interactions, so persistence is likely, but direct estimates are needed to interpret conditional stability.

Second, I test whether the accepted feature_027 and feature_063 clean-stratum associations are separable from the near-threshold feature_003 signal. I propose feature_063 in the triple-strong-absent, feature_027=0, feature_003=0 stratum, a stricter version of H89, and feature_027 in the triple-strong-absent, feature_063=0, feature_003=0 stratum, a stricter version of H91. The expected raw contrasts remain negative for both feature_063 and feature_027 because both are hypothesized to mark stronger dependency. If their lower bounds remain above 0.15 with adequate cells, this supports dataset-specific separability from feature_003; if intervals narrow or cross threshold, the accepted claims should remain interpreted as clean-stratum conditionals rather than broadly general marker effects. This avoids further chasing feature_003 itself, which remains unresolved.

Third, I add two heterogeneity probes that do not require new near-threshold marker claims. The first tests whether a high research-signature level on feature_038 identifies a larger feature_037 stronger-dependency effect. The direction is set to -1 to test whether the feature_037 association is amplified in the feature_038>=0.75 subgroup relative to its complement, but the anticipated raw interaction is uncertain. The second tests whether feature_037's association varies between feature_024 level_002 and its complement. feature_024 has two common nominal levels and adequate cells; H36 showed no marginal association, making it a useful negative-candidate heterogeneity variable. Both interaction claims should be interpreted only as dataset-specific contrasts among opaque nominal or constructed assay labels, not as biological mechanism.

The existing active probes H103-H109 remain useful: feature_034 level_003 versus level_002 adds broad categorical coverage; H104-H106 test whether feature_037, feature_010, and feature_002 retain their associations within feature_027=1; and H107-H109 add common predictor probes. The new proposals are higher priority if they have adequate cells because they complete the dominant-marker clinical-course pattern and test exact separability from feature_003, while the heterogeneity probes guard against over-assuming additivity. All proposed comparisons remain observational, and conditioning on accepted markers, log_pfs, or other strata can induce selection artifacts, especially where feature_027 or feature_063 exposed cells are modest. I will accept only threshold-exceeding intervals with adequate cells and will not reinterpret accepted dataset-specific associations as causal or generalizable.

prompt:
Iteration 9/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.

prompt:
Iteration 9/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative:
The new reciprocal f027=1 estimates provide useful corroboration of the core marker pattern but remain sparse. H104 estimates feature_037=1 versus 0 within feature_027=1 at +0.785 [0.580, 0.990]; H105 estimates feature_010=1 versus 0 within feature_027=1 at +0.835 [0.598, 1.071]; H106 estimates feature_002=1 versus 0 within feature_027=1 at +0.668 [0.425, 0.910]. All lower bounds exceed the 0.15-unit threshold and the directions match the accepted core pattern: feature_037 and feature_027 mark stronger dependency, while feature_010 and feature_002 mark weaker dependency. However, the exposed cells are only 29, 24, and 29, respectively. I therefore accept these as dataset-specific conditional associations but defer them; they support the conclusion that the dominant markers are not mutually exclusive artifacts of the clean strata, but they should not be treated as central independent discoveries.

The median-split clinical-course estimates are stronger. In the high-log_pfs, f037=0/f010=0 stratum, feature_002 remains strongly associated with weaker dependency: H113 is +0.844 [0.784, 0.905] with exposed n=123. The parallel high-log_pfs estimates for feature_037 (H111, +0.802 [0.735, 0.869]) and feature_010 (H112, +0.803 [0.731, 0.875]) are also threshold-exceeding with adequate cells. I accept H111 and H112 as completed conditional corroboration and close them because the core marginal associations for feature_037 and feature_010 are already accepted and large. H113 is the only new conditional claim that is both adequately powered and plausibly susceptible to conditioning-induced selection artifacts, because it conditions on high log_pfs and on absence of two accepted marker directions. I accept it provisionally but leave it active and request independent validation. If validation remains threshold-exceeding, the high-log_pfs feature_002 conditional association becomes more stable; if it fails, the marginal feature_002 finding remains supported, but H113 itself would need to be weakened or unresolved.

H110 tests feature_027 in the lower-log_pfs, triple-strong-absent stratum. It is +0.742 [0.639, 0.845] with exposed n=32, so it clears the threshold decisively despite the modest exposed cell. I accept it but defer it. It is consistent with the accepted validated feature_027 association and with the earlier high-log_pfs sparse estimate H97, but it remains a sparse conditional estimate and should not be elevated into a precise clinical-course-specific claim.

The broad probes and heterogeneity probe are negative. H103, feature_034 level_003 versus level_002, is near null: -0.012 [-0.150, 0.126]. H107, feature_047=1 versus 0, is +0.031 [-0.045, 0.107]. H108, feature_046 level_003 versus level_002, is -0.043 [-0.190, 0.103]. H109, feature_061 level_003 versus level_002, is -0.057 [-0.194, 0.080]. None provides evidence of a threshold-exceeding association in the claimed direction, so I reject and close these. H116 tests whether the feature_037 association is amplified when feature_038 is high. The interaction is +0.024 [-0.127, 0.176]; its upper bound alone touches the threshold, but the lower bound does not, so the evidence does not support a meaningful interaction. I reject and close it.

Overall, these results strengthen the core dataset-specific pattern: feature_037=1 and feature_027=1 are associated with stronger composite dependency, feature_010=1 and feature_002=1 with weaker dependency, and the large marker associations persist in many reciprocal and clinical-course strata. The sparse f027=1 conditionals and the lower-log_pfs f027 estimate should remain deferred because of small exposed cells. The validation request for H113 is intended to test whether one adequately powered but heavily conditioned high-log_pfs association is stable outside the discovery subset. All accepted statements remain observational associations in this dataset, not causal or generalizable claims.

Iteration 9/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).

record.narrative: The two due validations strengthen the already coherent core pattern and do not change the substantive conclusions. For H83, feature_027=1 versus 0 in the clean stratum feature_037=0, feature_010=0, and feature_002=0 gives discovery +0.745 [0.666, 0.825] and independent validation +0.779 [0.675, 0.884]. Both signed lower bounds are far above the 0.15-unit threshold, so the association of feature_027=1 with stronger composite dependency is robust in this clean context. I keep H83 accepted and closed. For H113, feature_002=1 versus 0 in the higher-log_pfs stratum with feature_037=0 and feature_010=0 gives discovery +0.844 [0.784, 0.905] and independent validation +0.804 [0.704, 0.903]. Because the hypothesis direction is +1, this signed positive estimate corresponds to feature_002=1 being associated with the claimed direction for that predictor, i.e. weaker composite dependency, and the independent lower bound remains well above threshold. I accept H113 and close it as a dataset-specific conditional robustness result. These validations reduce concern that the dominant-marker associations are artifacts of one stratum or selection in the high-log_pfs conditional. They do not support causal interpretation or generalization beyond the supplied dataset. The main supported pattern remains: feature_037=1 and feature_027=1 are associated with stronger composite dependency, while feature_010=1 and feature_002=1 are associated with weaker dependency. feature_063 remains supported primarily in the clean validated triple-strong-absent context and narrowly bounded clean conditionals; broad or sparse feature_063 variants remain unresolved. feature_003 remains near-threshold and unresolved. Negative findings include the research markers feature_007, feature_058, and feature_015 in marginal and tested signature/subgroup contrasts, feature_017, many low-prevalence binary markers, several nominal categorical contrasts, feature_034 level contrasts tested, feature_047, feature_046 level_003 versus level_002, feature_061 level_003 versus level_002, feature_053 value contrast, and the tested heterogeneity interactions of feature_037 with feature_010, feature_002, feature_040 median split, and feature_038 high threshold, plus feature_027 interactions with feature_037, feature_010, and feature_002. The most informative next analysis is to run the registered feature_037-by-feature_024 interaction probe H117 and avoid further feature_063 or feature_003 refinement unless a comparison has clearly adequate cells and a strong rationale. Sparse deferred claims such as H104-H106 and H110 should remain low-confidence corroboration rather than central discoveries.

Iteration 10/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect

The core dataset-specific accepted pattern is now well supported: feature_037=1 and feature_027=1 are associated with stronger composite dependency, while feature_010=1 and feature_002=1 are associated with weaker dependency. feature_063 remains bounded mainly to clean validated contexts, and feature_003 remains near-threshold; I will not further chase those near-threshold predictors. The new proposals therefore test robustness and context dependence of the accepted pattern in scientifically useful but previously untested strata. First, I register direct conditional estimates of feature_037, feature_010, and feature_002 in high research-signature strata using thresholds at feature_038, feature_018, and feature_036 >= 0.75. These test whether the dominant associations persist when participants have high constructed standardized-assay levels. The expected raw contrasts are negative for feature_037, corresponding to stronger dependency, and positive for feature_010 and feature_002, corresponding to weaker dependency. Alternatives are null or attenuated estimates, which would indicate context-specificity rather than broadly stable marker associations. Second, I complete a median-split full-numeric clinical-course check for feature_027 using feature_030 high versus low. feature_027 has enough total exposed observations that both halves should be adequate unless it is strongly associated with feature_030, and it is preferable to further sparse feature_027/feature_063 refinements. The expected raw contrast is negative in both halves, with possible nullity if the feature_027 association depends on another unmeasured or measured context. Third, I test previously unexplored categorical feature_062. The dominant level is level_003, and I propose a direct marginal contrast level_001 versus level_003 as broad coverage of an untested nominal predictor, with direction chosen arbitrarily as stronger dependency in level_001 and expectation uncertain. I also propose interaction probes asking whether the feature_037 and feature_010 associations differ between level_003 and its complement. Cells should be adequate because level_003 is common. The most plausible alternative is no threshold-exceeding interaction, given prior additive behavior of the accepted markers. Fourth, I add median-split interaction probes for the strongest marker feature_037 by feature_030 and for feature_010 by feature_008. These are fully observed numeric predictors, reducing missing-data ambiguity, and they test whether common clinical-course-like or quality-like variables modify accepted marker effects. Anticipation for interactions is uncertain. Acceptance will require interval lower bounds above 0.15 in the claimed direction and adequate cells; otherwise I will treat null or near-threshold results as dataset-specific context or measurement uncertainty. I do not request validation at explore, preserving validation capacity for genuinely new threshold-exceeding robustness questions. All proposed statements remain observational associations within the supplied dataset, not causal effects or claims about generalizability.

prompt:
Iteration 10/25, stage analyze, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Outcome-specific absolute effect-size thresholds:
- outcome_001: 0.15 composite dependency-score units
Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. New results enter the ledger after this form is accepted and are assessed in appraise. Any assessment in this form must use evidence already in the supplied ledger.

prompt:
Iteration 10/25, stage appraise, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.

record.narrative:
This batch mostly corroborates the core dataset-specific marker pattern and finds no new decisive heterogeneity or broad-predictor effects. H118-H120 directly test whether the dominant marker associations persist within high constructed standardized-assay strata. In the high feature_038 stratum, feature_037 remains strongly associated with stronger composite dependency: +0.821 [0.687, 0.956], exposed n=102, comparator n=357. In the high feature_018 stratum, feature_010 remains strongly associated in the claimed weaker-dependency direction: +0.738 [0.603, 0.874], n=99/369. In the high feature_036 stratum, feature_002 also remains strongly associated: +0.806 [0.664, 0.948], n=91/386. All signed lower bounds are far above the 0.15-unit threshold and all cells satisfy the minimum requirement. I accept H118-H120 and close them as completed robustness probes; they do not create new independent discoveries beyond the already accepted marginal marker pattern, but they make it less likely that the core associations are confined to one simple stratum.

H115 is the most useful new result. It estimates feature_027=1 versus 0 in the stricter clean stratum excluding feature_037, feature_010, feature_002, feature_063, and feature_003. The signed estimate is +0.747 [0.688, 0.806] with exposed n=45 and comparator n=668. The interval lower bound is far above threshold and the exposed cell is adequate, so I accept the claim as a dataset-specific conditional association. Because this comparison specifically addresses whether the accepted feature_027 association is merely a proxy for the bounded feature_063 context or the near-threshold feature_003 predictor, I request independent validation. H115 remains active pending that validation.

H121 estimates feature_027 in the high feature_030 half and is also threshold-exceeding: +0.775 [0.661, 0.890] with n=130/871. However, H122 shows the corresponding low feature_030 comparison is not estimable because there are zero exposed feature_027=1 observations in that half. Therefore H121 should be interpreted as a conditional association observed among high feature_030 participants and as evidence that all feature_027 exposed observations occur in the high feature_030 stratum; it is not a demonstrated median-split effect across the full feature_030 range. I accept H121 as completed conditional corroboration and close it, but I do not elevate it into a precise clinical-course or feature_030-dependent claim. H122 remains unresolved and closed because the requested low-stratum comparison had insufficient exposed observations and provides no usable evidence either way.

The new broad and interaction probes do not support threshold-exceeding associations. H117, the feature_037-by-feature_024 interaction, gives +0.174 [0.035, 0.312]. The point estimate exceeds the threshold, but the lower bound does not, so the evidence is not decisive for a scientifically meaningful interaction. Given the multiplicity of interaction probes, I reject and close it as lack of evidence for the claimed heterogeneity, not as proof of additivity. H123, feature_062 level_001 versus level_003, is +0.093 [-0.009, 0.196] and is rejected. The feature_037 and feature_010 interactions by feature_062 level_003 are also not supported: H124 gives -0.059 [-0.194, 0.076] and H125 gives +0.040 [-0.097, 0.177]. The median-split interactions H126 and H127 similarly fail the lower-bound threshold: H126 gives +0.072 [-0.052, 0.196] and H127 gives +0.019 [-0.106, 0.143]. I reject and close H123-H127. These are dataset-specific negative probes; they do not establish that no interaction or association exists, only that these tested contrasts do not provide evidence for threshold-exceeding effects. All accepted claims remain observational associations within the supplied dataset, without causal interpretation or assumed generalizability.

Iteration 10/25, stage synthesize, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_001 (composite dependency-score units). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use
previous results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are
both useful throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent
validation when useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
Research signatures (feature_038, feature_018, feature_036) are constructed standardized assays in arbitrary units. Research markers (feature_007, feature_058, feature_015) are constructed binary assays with no assigned gene, pathway, or clinical role.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

The endpoint is a composite dependency score; it does not represent a single gene's knockout measurement.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
Scientifically meaningful effects exceed the stated outcome-specific effect-size threshold in the claimed direction. Thresholds are absolute differences on the supplied outcome scale, not percentages of the outcome mean. Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of these thresholds. Acceptance does not require independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.

with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.
